notes: Source: 2026 New York Jets Media Guide (item new-york-jets-2026-media-guide-2026-08-12), JETS HISTORY, 'FRANCHISE RECORDS' (banner 'SOURCE: STATS PASS'), pdf pp. 316-323; the printed page number equals the pdf page number. RUSHING pp. 316-317, RECEIVING pp. 317-318, PASSING pp. 320-321, DEFENSE pp. 322-323 (the same pages also print running-back and tight-end lists, pp. 319-320; completions, completion percentage and touches, p. 321; scrimmage yards and touchdowns, p. 322; and kicking and return lists, pp. 323-327; none of those were used). All 30 scope/category pairs are lists ranked by exactly the stat (kind=list), so 'missing' is empty.

Every row was typed from the page pictures (110 dpi page views plus 170 dpi crops) and not from OCR text; the arithmetic columns were recomputed as a check (Yds/Att vs Avg, Comp/Att vs Pct, Solo+Asst vs Tkls) and all agree except two printed rounding quirks in the single-game rushing list (Thomas Jones 210 yds on 22 carries printed 9.6, Breece Hall 177 on 22 printed 8.1; the yardage digits are clear in the picture).

through_season 2025: the lists carry 2025 entries (Will McDonald IV 4.0 sacks on 11/9/2025, Jamien Sherwood 154 tackles in 2025, Garrett Wilson 2022-2025, Quincy Williams 2021-2025, Quinnen Williams 2019-2025) and the guide is the 2026 edition dated 2026-08-12. Titans-era (1960-62) entries are included as printed (Don Maynard 1960-1972, Al Dorow 1960-1961, Art Powell 1960, Lee Riley 1962, Johnny Green 11/22/1962).

The guide does not label these franchise-record lists regular season or postseason, and no separate postseason record lists were found in the franchise-records section (pp. 316-327), so every list is treated as the regular-season record book; nothing in the rows identifies a playoff game, but the guide itself does not say so.

Ranks are the printed ranks: a trailing 't' (printed '1t.', and '1t' without a period in the season receiving-TD list) is tie=true on every tied row. Every list is a top 10 and runs past ten rows only because of ties; complete_to is the number of rows the guide prints. pdf_page is the page where the list heading is; lists that run over a page break (rushing TDs single-game 316 to 317, receptions season 317 to 318, TD passes season 320 to 321, sacks season 322 to 323) say so in scope_note.

Career 'years' keep the printed span without the '(n)' season count (the count stays in raw); some tables print a space before '(n)' and others do not, years has none. Single-game 'years' are the printed dates M/D/YYYY. Opponent codes are the guide's own (BLT = Baltimore, BPA = Boston Patriots, HST = Houston Oilers, LAN = Los Angeles Rams, CLV = Cleveland, OAK, SD, STL, ARZ, WSH, DLT, KC, NO ...) and stay in raw only.

Three single-game tables carry misprinted column headers: rushing TDs prints 'Att Avg TDs' over a yards column (150, 44, 91 ...), receiving TDs prints 'Rec Avg Yds' over receptions/yards/TDs, and the sacks single-game table prints 'G' over the opponent code. The ranked stat (the last numeric column) was used in every case.

Tackles are total tackles (Solo + Asst, checked on every row). The footnote says '*Official as of 1994; Kyle Clifton's career numbers are incomplete.' (Clifton's career row, 1984-1996, carries the asterisks).

Sacks: all three lists are headed '(Since 1982)' and the footnote reads '*Sacks did not become an offical NFL statistic until 1982. Asterisk denotes incomplete data.' (printed 'offical'). Mark Gastineau's career span prints 1979-1988 and his Tkls cell is a printed '-' (as are Dennis Byrd's and Gastineau's season/game cells). Marvin Washington's and Jeff Lageman's Tkls carry the incomplete-data asterisk.

Interceptions: footnote '*Incomplete data; stats not officially tracked.' Asterisks sit on Dainard Paulson (29, 343, 47), Larry Grantham (24, 308, 41t), Bobby Jackson (21, 196, 77t) and on the Long column of Revis, Glenn, Victor Green (87*), McMillan and Atkinson/Owens; 't' marks a touchdown return. A '-' in a single-game Long cell is a printed blank. Digits of the interception counts themselves are clear in every row.
First draft note: an earlier pass at this file was discarded because several page images had not displayed; everything in this version was re-read from the images that did display.
